about_page.title: About Us – DataX
about_page.intro1: DataX stands for data-driven solutions that make companies clearer, more efficient and more successful. Our goal is to transform complex data into understandable information and create tangible added value for your daily business.
about_page.intro2: With experience in analysis, business intelligence and process optimization, we develop solutions that not only convince technically but also deliver noticeable results in operational use. We rely on clear communication, transparent processes and practical concepts that adapt flexibly to the needs of your company.
about_page.intro3: The focus is always on making data usable in a way that facilitates decisions, saves resources and promotes growth. DataX accompanies you from the first idea to the final implementation and ensures that you always have an overview of your most important key figures.
about_page.mission_text: To support companies in turning data into success.
about_page.claim_text: Simple, understandable and effective – for solutions that really work in everyday life.
